host.description: IP address or hostname of the target SMB host.

username.description: Username for SMB authentication. Leave empty for null session.

password.description: Password or NTLM hash for the user.

mode.description: Primary mode of operation: 'list' (enumerate shares), 'recursive' (list files), 'command' (execute remote command), 'share' (list specific share).

show_version.description: Return the OS version of the remote host (-v).

no_banner.description: Remove the banner from the output (--no-banner).

quiet.description: Quiet mode, only show shares with READ/WRITE (-q).

admin_only.description: Just report if the user is an admin (--admin).

share.description: Specify a specific share to target (-s).

command.description: Command to execute on the remote host (-x).

depth.description: Traverse directory tree to specific depth (--depth).

search_timeout.description: Timeout for file content search jobs in seconds (--search-timeout).

search_path.description: Path to search for file content (--search-path).

file_search_pattern.description: Pattern to search for in file contents (-F).

exclude_shares.description: List of shares to exclude from search and listing (--exclude). Items are strings representing share names.
